name: Entry Reports for Gravity Forms
author: Michael Ott

sections.description:
Entry Reports for Gravity Forms gives you a clear, visual breakdown of form submissions over time. Just pick a form and set your date range to see exactly how many entries were submitted each day within that period.

When is this useful?

  • You might be running a marketing campaign and want to track form performance over time
  • You’re curious to see entry trends across any specific date range
  • You need a quick way to relay submission activity to your team or clients

Support

Free Plugin Support | Pro Plugin Support

Requirements

  • Gravity Forms 2.4 or higher
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.1

Upgrade to PRO

What are the benefits of PRO?

  1. Export Data: Quickly export to CSV.
  2. Automated Email Reports: Schedule reports to be automatically sent to selected recipients at specific days and times.
  3. Calendar heat map: Show daily submission activity with color-coded intensity to visualise trends over time.
  4. Submission trends by hour:Instantly see when submissions peak with an hourly breakdown for any selected day.
  5. Customise Chart Colours: Easily adjust chart colours using either baked-in presets or choose your own.
  6. One-click chart screenshots: Save charts to PNG.

Upgrade to PRO
sections.installation:
1. Search for ‘Entry Reports for Gravity Forms’ in the WordPress ‘Add Plugins’ page.
  2. Click Install Now.
  3. Click Activate when it’s finished downloading.
sections.faq:
Does it work with all form entries?

Yes. You can evaluate entries from any point in time, even those submitted before the plugin was activated.

Where is the interface?

Go to Forms -> Entry Reports

How do I view a report?

  1. Go to Forms -> Entry Reports and click on a form name.
  2. Choose the start and end dates you want to evaluate (click the calendar icon or type into the field).
  3. Enable Days (optional, but recommended).
  4. Click the Get Report button.

Note: While on this page you can quickly change to a different form.
